svg.title: Shop data model
svg.desc: Er diagram with 4 parts: CUSTOMER uuid id PK string name string email, ORDER uuid id PK uuid customer_id FK date placed_at string status, ORDER_LINE uuid order_id FK uuid product_id FK int quantity, PRODUCT uuid id PK string name decimal price.
